parameters.content:
## ⚡ Renewable Microgrid Arbitrage & Curtailment Dispatch
**Profile:** Academic & Industrial Grid Modeling (Grenoble INP Ense3 / INSA Lyon benchmark)

**How to Use:**
1. Click **"Test workflow"** or wait for the daily 23:00 schedule trigger.
2. Review aggregated financial metrics in **PersistDailyTelemetry** and peak alerts in **DispatchAlertWebhook**.

### 1. Ingestion (Day-Ahead)
Fetches 24-hour inputs in parallel:
• **Spot Prices:** EPEX Spot / RTE France Day-Ahead
• **Solar Irradiance:** Open-Meteo GHI (Grenoble 45.19°N, 5.72°E)
• **Campus Load:** 24h baseline demand profile

### 2. Time-Series Alignment
Combines the three parallel data streams by hourly position into an aligned 24-item dataset.

### 3. Dispatch Optimizer
**Battery:** 200 kWh / 50 kW (90% round-trip $\eta$)
• Dynamic price quartiles ($Q_1$ charge, $Q_4$ discharge)
• Solar curtailment control ($P_{solar} > P_{load}$)
• Hourly cost & arbitrage savings calculation

### 4. Directives Routing & Peak Alerting
Routes each hour to **DISCHARGE**, **CHARGE**, **CURTAIL**, or **IDLE**.
Hours discharging during **$Q_4$ Peak Tariff** trigger an automated webhook alert with real-time operational payload.

### 5. Daily Aggregation & PostgreSQL Telemetry
Aggregates 24-hour energy totals and financial savings, automatically initializing and upserting into `microgrid_daily_telemetry`.

parameters.query:
=CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS microgrid_daily_telemetry (
  delivery_date DATE PRIMARY KEY,
  total_solar_yield_kwh NUMERIC(10,2),
  total_grid_import_kwh NUMERIC(10,2),
  total_grid_export_kwh NUMERIC(10,2),
  curtailed_energy_kwh NUMERIC(10,2),
  baseline_cost_eur NUMERIC(10,2),
  optimized_cost_eur NUMERIC(10,2),
  net_daily_arbitrage_savings_eur NUMERIC(10,2),
  recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO microgrid_daily_telemetry (
  delivery_date,
  total_solar_yield_kwh,
  total_grid_import_kwh,
  total_grid_export_kwh,
  curtailed_energy_kwh,
  baseline_cost_eur,
  optimized_cost_eur,
  net_daily_arbitrage_savings_eur,
  recorded_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.delivery_date }}',
  {{ $json.total_solar_yield_kwh }},
  {{ $json.total_grid_import_kwh }},
  {{ $json.total_grid_export_kwh }},
  {{ $json.curtailed_energy_kwh }},
  {{ $json.baseline_cost_eur }},
  {{ $json.optimized_cost_eur }},
  {{ $json.net_daily_arbitrage_savings_eur }},
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (delivery_date) DO UPDATE SET
  total_solar_yield_kwh = EXCLUDED.total_solar_yield_kwh,
  total_grid_import_kwh = EXCLUDED.total_grid_import_kwh,
  total_grid_export_kwh = EXCLUDED.total_grid_export_kwh,
  curtailed_energy_kwh = EXCLUDED.curtailed_energy_kwh,
  baseline_cost_eur = EXCLUDED.baseline_cost_eur,
  optimized_cost_eur = EXCLUDED.optimized_cost_eur,
  net_daily_arbitrage_savings_eur = EXCLUDED.net_daily_arbitrage_savings_eur,
  recorded_at = NOW();
